items.headline: Base PS5 Finally Gets Its Own Version of PSSR Upscaling
items.excerpt: Sony's new Quick Spectral Super Resolution (QSSR) uses a streamlined neural network to bring PS5 Pro-style AI upscaling to the base PS5, starting with Marvel's Wolverine and Ghost of Yotei.
items.title: Base PS5 Finally Gets Its Own Version of PSSR Upscaling

items.headline: PS5 AI Upscaling Rolls Out With Already Mixed Results
items.excerpt: TheGamer's hands-on take finds Sony's new QSSR AI upscaler on the base PS5 delivers only minimal visible gains so far in its first two supported games.
items.title: PS5 AI Upscaling Rolls Out With Already Mixed Results

items.headline: Sony Announces QSSR, a Trimmed Down Version of PSSR That Finally Brings AI Upscaling to Base PS5
items.excerpt: Sony's QSSR is a lighter neural upscaler that runs on the base PS5's weaker GPU, extending the PS5 Pro's PSSR pipeline to the whole install base.
items.title: Sony Announces QSSR, a Trimmed Down Version of PSSR That Finally Brings AI Upscaling to Base PS5

items.headline: 일반 PS5 생명 연장, 프로에만 있던 'AI 업스케일' 도입된다
items.excerpt: 소니가 일반 PS5용 AI 업스케일링 라이브러리 QSSR(퀵 스펙트럴 슈퍼 레졸루션)을 발표했다. 신경망을 간소화해 일반 PS5에서도 고품질 그래픽 구현이 가능해졌다는 설명이다.
items.title: 일반 PS5 생명 연장, 프로에만 있던 'AI 업스케일' 도입된다

items.headline: Layer launches AI Playable ad generator to tackle production bottlenecks for mobile game studios
items.excerpt: Layer, an agentic creative platform for game studios, launched Playables, which builds end-to-end, network-ready HTML5 playable ads in hours rather than weeks.
items.title: Layer launches AI Playable ad generator to tackle production bottlenecks for mobile game studios

items.headline: Twitch Is Using AI To Decide Which Streamers Can Make Money Off Ads
items.excerpt: Twitch is now using AI classification of stream content to decide which creators are eligible for ad revenue, drawing pushback from streamers.
items.title: Twitch Is Using AI To Decide Which Streamers Can Make Money Off Ads

items.headline: [이슈] 던전앤파이터, 신규 이벤트 AI 일러스트 논란에 '교체'
items.excerpt: 던전앤파이터 신규 이벤트의 레전더리 카드 일러스트가 AI 활용 논란에 휩싸였고, 넥슨은 일부 이미지에 AI를 활용했다고 밝힌 뒤 해당 일러스트를 교체하기로 했다.
items.title: [이슈] 던전앤파이터, 신규 이벤트 AI 일러스트 논란에 '교체'

items.headline: Can you tell which of these images has been injected with DLSS 5?
items.excerpt: PC Gamer runs GTA 6 trailer frames through DLSS 5 neural rendering at varying intensities, challenging readers to tell the AI-reinterpreted images from the originals.
items.title: Can you tell which of these images has been injected with DLSS 5?

items.headline: DLSS 4.5 Comes To Radeon RX 9000 GPUs In Experimental Mod Using AMD's Native FP8 Capabilities
items.excerpt: A new d4r release adds experimental NVIDIA DLSS 4 and 4.5 support to AMD RDNA 4 GPUs by running the neural upscaler on native FP8 hardware.
items.title: DLSS 4.5 Comes To Radeon RX 9000 GPUs In Experimental Mod Using AMD's Native FP8 Capabilities

items.headline: UEFN Claude Team Starter Kit v1.84 — an AI dev team for your Fortnite map
items.excerpt: A community kit turns Claude Code plus Unreal MCP into a visible multi-agent 'AI dev team' for UEFN map building, with a live dashboard and memory that learns from each shipped map.
items.title: UEFN Claude Team Starter Kit v1.84 — an AI dev team for your Fortnite map

items.headline: Sina — a 100% local AI digital human that walks the level and operates Blueprint equipment
items.excerpt: A UE5 plugin links any project to a local AI 'brain' so a MetaHuman can talk, move through the level and operate Blueprint-driven equipment with no cloud AI.
items.title: Sina — a 100% local AI digital human that walks the level and operates Blueprint equipment

items.headline: Introducing the official Unity plugin for Grok Build
items.excerpt: Unity introduces an official plugin for xAI's Grok Build coding agent, bringing Unity engineering guidance directly into the terminal for AI-assisted game development.
items.title: Introducing the official Unity plugin for Grok Build

items.headline: Community Tutorial: Building Conversational AI NPCs in Unreal Engine 5 with Codex and GPT-6 Astra
items.excerpt: A step-by-step guide to animated NPCs with AI-generated dialogue and conversation history, built with Codex, Unreal MCP, UnrealAI and the OpenAI API.
items.title: Community Tutorial: Building Conversational AI NPCs in Unreal Engine 5 with Codex and GPT-6 Astra

items.headline: "AI upscaling is coming to PS5": Sony's base console is getting its own version of a PS5 Pro feature
items.excerpt: Marvel's Wolverine and Ghost of Yotei are the first games to use Sony's new QSSR neural upscaler on the base PS5.
items.title: "AI upscaling is coming to PS5": Sony's base console is getting its own version of a PS5 Pro feature
